jobs.title: Sr Accessibility Product Manager, Clinical Solutions
jobs.excerpt: Sr.  Accessibility Product ManagerAre you passionate about building accessible products that serve a diverse community of clinicians and healthcare professionals?
jobs.description:
Sr. Accessibility Product Manager

Are you passionate about building accessible products that serve a diverse community of clinicians and healthcare professionals?

Do you thrive in leading complex, cross-functional programs that drive meaningful, measurable impact across a global product portfolio?

About the Role
In this role, you will lead the accessibility program for a broad portfolio of Clinical Solutions products, ensuring they meet evolving accessibility standards and support the needs of a diverse user base. You will set strategy, oversee execution, and guide teams to embed accessibility into product development practices. This position operates with high visibility and contributes directly to product quality, compliance, and customer trust.

Responsibilties

Own the Accessibility Program

  • Assess the current compliance posture, identify gaps, and drive the program from where it is to where it needs to be

  • Own conformance documentation (VPATs/ACRs) across all active products — ensuring everything is current, accurate, and ready for enterprise procurement

  • Partner with Legal on ADA Title III obligations, contractual commitments, and customer inquiries; be the person who knows where the risks are before they become escalations

  • Stay ahead of the legal and regulatory landscape — enforcement trends, emerging state statutes, and international equivalents for our global cu

jobs.title: Digital Accessibility Specialist
jobs.excerpt: The Digital Accessibility Specialist will play a key role in creating accessible and inclusive digital experiences across web and mobile products.
jobs.description:
The Digital Accessibility Specialist will play a key role in creating accessible and inclusive digital experiences across web and mobile products. Working closely with Accessibility Consultants, Designers, Researchers and Engineering teams, this role will contribute to accessibility reviews, design recommendations and the integration of accessibility best practices throughout the product lifecycle.

The role will support the identification of accessibility barriers, contribute to remediation efforts and help promote inclusive design practices across multidisciplinary teams.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct accessibility reviews of digital products across web and mobile platforms.

  • Identify accessibility barriers and provide clear, actionable recommendations for improvement.

  • Collaborate with Designers, Engineers and Product teams to integrate accessibility requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Support accessibility assessments and contribute to the documentation of findings and recommendations.

  • Review user journeys and interfaces from an accessibility perspective.

  • Translate accessibility requirements and standards into practical guidance for design and development teams.

  • Contribute to accessibility awareness and inclusive design practices across multidisciplinary teams.
